recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色中，成片單一型態的中小型淋巴球全部呈強烈膜陽性，核圓至略不規則，只有血管內皮與間質細胞陰性，證明是 B 細胞腫瘤；需搭配 CD5、cyclin D1/SOX11 才能判定為被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Strong, uniform membranous CD20 staining in virtually all tumor cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with scant to moderate cytoplasm
No residual CD20-negative T-cell rich areas evident in the field
Negative stromal and endothelial cells along small vessels
describe_en: CD20 immunostain shows diffuse sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with strong, uniform membranous positivity. The tumor cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei with scant cytoplasm, while vessels and stromal cells are negative. This establishes a diffuse B-cell population; in the context of the reference case, the findings support mantle cell lymphoma, which requires CD5 co-expression and cyclin D1 or SOX11 positivity for confirmation.

ddx.vs: SLL shows proliferation centers and dim CD20 with CD23+/LEF1+ and cyclin D1-negative cells.
FL is CD10+/BCL6+ with centrocytes and centroblasts and is CD5- and cyclin D1-negative.
MZL has monocytoid/plasmacytoid cells and is CD5-, CD10- and cyclin D1-negative.
These have larger cells with finer chromatin or vesicular nuclei and high Ki-67, which cannot be judged on CD20 alone.
